specification.purpose: Service worker that manages tab counting and limit enforcement per window
requirements: Track tab count per window independently
Check against stored limits when new tab created
Open selector window when limit exceeded
Handle tab removal after user selection
Clean up data for closed windows

implementation_order: Create storage.js with get/set functions for tab limits
Set up background.js service worker structure
Add placeholder for selector window opening

storage_functions.getDefaultLimit: Get default limit for new windows

background_logic.tab_tracking: Map to track current tab count per window
background_logic.onTabCreated: Check if new tab exceeds limit
background_logic.openSelector: Function to open selector window (stub for now)

data_structures.pendingTabs: Set: tabs waiting for user selection

background.js: Add detailed console logging for debugging

test_requirements: Tab count updates correctly when tabs open/close
Limit check triggers at right threshold
No memory leaks with window/tab tracking
important_notes: Must handle rapid tab creation (e.g., restore session)
For now, just log when limit exceeded (selector will come later)
Ensure service worker stays active during operations
